candidates.name: Existing signed KBD runtime and apply/reconcile path
candidates.fit_for_gap: #194 prevention, duplicate diagnosis and evidence-preserving authorized repair

evidence.claim: New ChangeRegistered events already reject an existing phase-map key.
Legacy conversion collects rows into a BTreeMap by embedded ID; duplicate rows can overwrite earlier values.
Boundary resolution is active-phase scoped; qualified task lookup uses map keys before an ID/title fallback.
Duplicate progress IDs currently cause a generic scan error.

risks: Affected 1.11.3 journal unavailable: no incident reproduction or root-cause certification.
A merge must not fabricate task completion or rewrite signed history.
candidates.decision_rationale: Add targeted identity inspection and an explicit typed, signed repair path only for confirmed canonical damage; preserve existing guards and receipts. Readiness: scenarioMatrix, evidenceInvalidation and boundaryPacket; current runtime does not expose the needed repair command.

candidates.name: Existing adopted contract, decisions, readiness and typed phase closure
candidates.fit_for_gap: #195/#196 single contract authority and scenario-to-evidence-to-closure binding

evidence.claim: Contract has stable scenario IDs, oracle, negativeControl, budgets, evidence invalidation, workerRoutes and a single post-implementation boundary packet.
Typed closure already handles pass/refusal and refuses unsupported cancelled/deferred dispositions.

risks: Reuse is not current execution evidence.
Any necessary schema extension must retain digest normalization and existing adoption authority.
candidates.decision_rationale: No parallel ledger or generic closure replacement. Readiness: identity, adoptionSource, scenarioMatrix, budgets, workerRoutes and boundaryPacket; existing machinery can support the integration, but #194 repair still needs production code.

candidates.name: Bootstrap, KBD handoff and team prompt/provenance surfaces
candidates.fit_for_gap: #195 compact method/contract/authority recovery through new and delegated sessions

evidence.claim: Role prompt already exports outcome, ownership, inputs, outputs, dependencies and skills.
Selected provenance already hashes source/evidence files and warns that observation transfers no authority.
Handoff has readInOrder, targetChecks, warnings and startPrompt.
Recovery restores position, not VLBV method/calibration/supersession references.

risks: Generic references need explicit stable semantics; prompt visibility alone does not enforce behavior.
Do not silently rewrite operator-owned instructions.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reuse inputs, selected file provenance and handoff references before proposing additive schema fields. Readiness: workerRoutes, identity, amendmentPolicy, evidenceInvalidation and budgets; compact propagation needs implementation, not a new runtime authority.

candidates.name: Cucumber.js via existing bdd-cucumber-js adapter
candidates.fit_for_gap: #196 author-only instructions and bounded phase-end JS execution/report retention

evidence.claim: Dry-run loads support code, skips steps and does not fail on undefined/ambiguous steps; it is neither author-only nor assertion evidence.
Existing message formatters expose runner results; no replacement runner is necessary.
Read-only npm metadata reports 13.3.0, MIT. This does not authorize changing consumer dependency pins.

risks: Never import support code, install dependencies or run dry-run during author-only invocation.
Process success and formatter results alone do not prove the contract oracle.
candidates.decision_rationale: Keep existing runner; adapt skill routing and scenario/assertion/evidence links. Readiness: scenarioMatrix and boundaryPacket; no new general-purpose runner runtime needed.

candidates.name: cucumber-rs via existing bdd-cucumber-rs adapter
candidates.fit_for_gap: #196 author-only instructions and bounded phase-end Rust integration execution

evidence.claim: Existing output supports Cucumber JSON, JUnit and libtest integrations.
Registry reports stable 0.23.0 and MIT OR Apache-2.0; this matches the current skill major/minor guidance.

risks: Cargo builds/checks/test execution remain deferred to the authorized complete-phase boundary.
JSON or libtest output is not by itself a retained value assertion.
candidates.decision_rationale: Adapt the existing Rust skill, preserve package pins and use a targeted real integration entry point at phase end. Readiness: scenarioMatrix and boundaryPacket; no replacement runner.

candidates.name: Published VLBV method and supersession procedure
candidates.fit_for_gap: #195 selected-method semantics; #196 bounded relevance discovery and calibration

evidence.claim: Method source read during Assess: pre-generation acceptance planning, owner calibration, complete-value-phase verification and explicit supersession; not product qualification.

risks: No project adoption or execution permission follows merely from the paper.
Scenario selection needs owner-reviewed examples; do not invent probabilities or weights.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reference the independent method and build a small pack-specific discovery/routing procedure. Readiness: functionalScope, exclusions, scenarioMatrix, amendmentPolicy; generic library adoption cannot supply project value judgments.

candidates.name: Replacement orchestrator, runner or parallel acceptance ledger

evidence.claim: Existing contract already owns finite acceptance and boundary identity.
Existing signed runtime owns closure semantics.

risks: Duplicates authority and increases migration scope contrary to issue exclusions.
candidates.decision_rationale: Existing runtime, adapters and contract are adequate foundations. Readiness is improved by targeted integration, not framework replacement.

build_required.need: Explicit duplicate identity diagnostics, legacy/import preservation and authorized repair in existing runtime/apply path
build_required.why_no_candidate: Domain-specific signed journal, embedded IDs, task receipts and counter semantics cannot be delegated to a generic deduplication library. Incident-specific mapping remains conditional on evidence.

build_required.need: Compact selected-method and phase-authority reference propagation through bootstrap, dispatch, handoffs and recovery
build_required.why_no_candidate: Existing fields/provenance can carry references, but selection, supersession and governing-policy resolution need project-specific integration.

build_required.need: Small separately invocable scenario discovery procedure plus explicit BDD author-only and phase-end execution routing
build_required.why_no_candidate: Runners execute scenarios; they do not adopt useful scope, calibrate relevance, grant authority or establish oracle sensitivity.
